held.reason: Write the notified body's words first.

explainer.rule: A garment may be labelled, released and shipped only when a valid certificate covers its style, colour and size on that day.
explainer.coveredIntro: “Covered” means all of these, on the day asked:

covered.status: The certificate is Valid (not a draft, suspended, withdrawn or expired).
covered.dates: The day is inside its Valid from – Valid to.
covered.style: The style is in its coverage.
covered.colour: The colourway is covered (or all colourways are).
covered.size: The size is covered (or the whole range is).
covered.mtm: Made-to-measure: the rider’s measures fall inside the covered sizes’ body measures.

stop.label: Garment label print on the floor

list.intro: The EU type-examination certificates of our garments, protectors and gloves: what each covers and until when.
list.exportNothing: Nothing to export in this view
list.failedTitle: The register could not be read

empty.title: No certificates yet
empty.body: Add the notified body’s certificate with its PDF, then say which styles and sizes it covers.
empty.bodyView: The compliance office adds the certificates; they show here.

row.check: Check a garment with this certificate

noAccess.title: Not for your role
noAccess.body: The certificate register needs the permission to view certificates (compliance.certificates.view): the compliance lead, quality or an administrator grants it.

tileHint.expiring: Ask the notified body for the renewal
tileHint.suspended: The gate refuses what they covered

held.registerMax: The register shows the first {max} certificates: narrow it with a view or a search.
held.manage: Your role does not change certificates (compliance.certificates.manage).
held.upload: Your role does not upload files (files.upload).

notice.suspended_one: {number} suspended by notified body {body}: the gate refuses the {count} style or part it covered.
notice.suspended_other: {number} suspended by notified body {body}: the gate refuses the {count} styles or parts it covered.
notice.pastValidity: {number} is past its last valid day ({date}): it covers nothing from today.
notice.expiringSoon_one: {number} ends in {count} day ({date}): ask the notified body for its renewal.
notice.expiringSoon_other: {number} ends in {count} days ({date}): ask the notified body for its renewal.

done.copyFailed: This browser did not allow copying.
done.registered: {number} is registered: it covers what it lists from its first valid day.
done.suspend: {number} is suspended: the gate refuses what it covered.
done.withdraw: {number} is withdrawn: it covers nothing any more.
done.coverageEnded: The coverage of {code} is ended (kept in the list of ended coverage).

add.title: Add certificate
add.intro: Type it as the notified body wrote it. It is created as a draft: it covers nothing until it has its PDF and coverage and is registered.
add.pdfHint: The notified body’s signed PDF. You can also add it later on the record.
add.after: Next: say which styles, colourways and sizes it covers, then register it.
add.fiveYearsLaw: An EU type-examination certificate is valid for at most five years (Reg. (EU) 2016/425 Annex V): the last day can be {latest} at the latest.

problem.holder: Choose who holds it: our company or the brand.
problem.number: Type the certificate number as the notified body wrote it.
problem.bodyNumber: The notified body’s number has four digits, as NANDO lists it.
problem.standard: Write the standard with its edition, as “EN 17092-4:2020”.
problem.standardPart: Name the part of EN 17092 that grants the class (part 2 to 6).
problem.class: Write the class or level as the certificate states it (letters or digits).
problem.level: An EN 1621 protector has level 1 or 2.
problem.validToOrder: The last valid day comes after the first.
problem.fiveYears: At most {years} years: the last day can be {latest} at the latest.
problem.refused: The register refused this field: see below.
problem.duplicate: This notified body already has a certificate with this number in the register.
problem.invalid: The register refused the certificate as it is.
problem.failed: The certificate was not created. Try again.

field.standardHint: The harmonised standard and edition on the certificate.
field.classGranted: The part of EN 17092 grants this class.
field.numberHint: As the notified body wrote it.
field.holderHint: With a brand label the brand is the legal maker.
field.bodyNumberHint: Four digits, as NANDO lists it.
field.validToHint: At most five years after the first day.

check.title: Check a garment
check.intro: May this garment be labelled, released and shipped on that day? The answer says which certificate covers it, or why not and how to fix it.
check.otherDay: Another day: for an audit or a complaint

held.styles: Your role does not read styles (product.styles.view).

check.stops: Until it is fixed the work order is not released, the label is not printed and the garment is not shipped.

gate.no_certificate: No valid certificate covers this style.
gate.certificate_not_valid: The certificate that would cover it is not valid (a draft, suspended or withdrawn).
gate.certificate_expired: The certificate that covered it has ended.
gate.certificate_not_yet_valid: The certificate is not valid yet on that day.
gate.size_not_covered: This size is outside the covered range.
gate.style_not_made_to_measure: The style is not made to measure.
gate.made_to_measure_not_allowed: The certificate does not cover made-to-measure units.
gate.body_measures_missing: The covered sizes have no body measures to compare with.
gate.measurement_missing: A measure of the rider is missing.
gate.measurement_invalid: A measure of the rider is not a usable number.
gate.measurement_outside: A measure of the rider is outside the covered sizes’ body measures.

gateFix.no_certificate: Compliance: add the notified body’s certificate and its coverage, or take the style off the order.
gateFix.certificate_not_valid: Compliance: register the draft, or ask the notified body to reinstate it.
gateFix.certificate_expired: Compliance: ask the notified body for the renewal and add the new certificate.
gateFix.certificate_not_yet_valid: Wait for its first valid day, or ask about a later day.
gateFix.colourway_not_covered: Compliance: ask the notified body to add the colourway, or take it off the order.
gateFix.size_not_covered: Compliance: ask the notified body to extend the certificate, or take the size off the order.
gateFix.style_not_made_to_measure: Product office: allow made-to-measure on the style, or order a standard size.
gateFix.made_to_measure_not_allowed: Compliance: ask the notified body to cover made-to-measure, or order a standard size.
gateFix.body_measures_missing: Product office: add the body measures to the size scale.
gateFix.measurement_outside: Compliance: ask the notified body about the size, or make a standard size.

record.noPanels: The thread, files and history are shown here.
record.panelsHeld: The thread, files and history need the permission to read threads (threads.read).

state.draft: A draft covers nothing: add its PDF and what it covers, then register it.
state.registered: Registered – only its status can change; a correction is a new certificate.
state.pastValidity: Its last valid day was {date}: it covers nothing from today (the night’s run marks it expired).
state.suspendedBlocks: Until it is valid again the gate refuses every garment it covered: no work order release, no label, no shipment.
state.withdrawn: Withdrawn on {date}: it covers nothing any more.
state.expired: Expired: its last valid day was {date}.
state.expiredBlocks: The garments it covered cannot be labelled, released or shipped under it. A renewal is a new certificate.

details.title: The certificate
details.draft: As typed from the notified body’s paper; a draft can still be corrected.
details.editing: Each field is checked as you leave it.

register.title: Before registering
register.once: Once registered only its status changes. A correction is a new certificate.

pdf.name: PDF
pdf.ok: The notified body’s PDF is on the certificate.
pdf.open: The notified body’s PDF is missing.
pdf.fix: Add it on the Files tab.

data.name: Data
data.ok: Number, notified body, class and dates pass their checks, five years at most.
data.open: A field does not pass its check.

validity.name: Validity
validity.ok: Its last valid day has not passed.
validity.open: Its last valid day has passed.
validity.fix: An ended certificate is not registered: add the renewal instead.

coverage.name: Coverage
coverage.ok: It covers at least one style or part.

held.pdf: Add the notified body’s PDF first.
held.data: A field of the draft does not pass its check.
held.validity: Its last valid day has passed.

suspend.title: Mark {number} suspended
suspend.what: Record the notified body’s suspension. It only protects: from now on the gate refuses what it covers, until it is reinstated.
suspend.impact_one: The gate will refuse the garments of this style or part:
suspend.impact_other: The gate will refuse the garments of these {count} styles or parts:

withdraw.title: Mark {number} withdrawn
withdraw.what: Withdrawn is final: it covers nothing any more and cannot be reinstated. A new certificate is a new record.
withdraw.impact_one: It will no longer cover this style or part:
withdraw.impact_other: It will no longer cover these {count} styles or parts:

reinstate.title: Reinstate {number}
reinstate.what: The notified body lifted the suspension: the certificate covers again from today, within its dates.
reinstate.impact_one: It covers again this style or part:
reinstate.impact_other: It covers again these {count} styles or parts:

move.nothingCovered: It covers no style or part now.
move.notServed: The open work orders, garments in stock and shipments it touches are not listed here yet.

coverage.title: What it covers
coverage.intro: Per style: its colourways × sizes. A part (a protector) is listed below.

empty.title: It covers nothing yet
empty.draft: Add the styles (or the protector) the notified body examined, with their colourways and sizes.
empty.body: Nothing is covered by it now.

coverage.loadingStyle: Reading the style’s colourways and sizes…
coverage.styleFailed: The style’s colourways and sizes could not be read: the coverage holds as written above.
coverage.styleHeld: Your role does not read styles: the coverage holds as written above.
coverage.noColourways: The style has no colourway yet.
coverage.itemSearch: Search the material code or name
coverage.mtmHint: Covered when the rider’s measures fall inside the covered sizes’ body measures.
coverage.mtmStyleOff: The style itself is not made to measure.
coverage.noteHint: Which report or letter of the notified body says so.

held.already: It is covered by this certificate already: end that coverage first to change it.
held.materials: Your role does not read materials (product.materials.view).

coverage.endWhat: From now on this certificate no longer covers it.
coverage.endKept: The coverage is kept, ended, in the certificate’s history (never deleted).
coverage.endWiden: To widen it, add the new coverage after.

lapse.title: What it blocks when it lapses
lapse.intro: Ask the certificate gate, on a day you choose, about every garment it covers: what it would refuse and why.
lapse.failed: The gate did not answer. Try again.
lapse.refused_one: On {date} the gate would refuse {count} of {total} garment.
lapse.refused_other: On {date} the gate would refuse {count} of {total} garments.
lapse.allCovered: On {date} all {total} garments are still covered.
lapse.stopsIntro: For each refused garment, the gate stops:
lapse.coveredBy: Still covered on that day by {number}.
lapse.stillThis: Still covered by this certificate on that day.

held.nothing: It covers no garment of a style.

lapse.notServed: The open work orders, stock and shipments behind these garments are not counted here yet.

body.title: Notified body
body.intro: Who examined the type and issued the certificate.
body.name: Name
body.numberHint: As the EU’s NANDO list names it.

files.title: The certificate’s PDF
files.hasPdf: The notified body’s PDF is on file.
files.noPdf: No PDF yet: a certificate is registered only with it.

held.status: A {status} certificate takes no new PDF.

files.readHeld: Your role does not read files (files.read).

empty.title: No PDF yet
empty.body: Upload the notified body’s signed PDF.

retention.title: Kept
retention.body: Kept {years} years after its last valid day: at least until {date} (Reg. (EU) 2016/425 art. 8(3)).
retention.added: Files of a registered certificate are added, never replaced.

files.onlyPdf: Only a PDF can be the certificate’s file.
files.uploadFailed: The PDF was not sent. Try again.
files.uploadFailedAfterCreate: The draft is created but its PDF was not sent: upload it here.
files.downloadFailed: The file could not be downloaded.

write.conflict: Someone changed the certificate in the meantime: it has been read again.
write.invalid: The register refused it as it is.
write.notFound: It is not there any more.
write.failed: It was not saved. Try again.
